label: preparing
what: A privately funded jubilee-related committee presentation or gathering in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with 200 planned loaves, tables and lighting, initially presented to the mayor as a lighting inspection. Explicit reported request for secrecy until eighteen supports initial concealment, though secretary subsequently disclosed jubilee supplies and secrecy to mayor. Secretary knowingly helped with attendance/logistics after disclosure, not demonstrably concealment. Neighbour and watchman knew some details but knowing assistance with the concealed event is not established.
